name: 菌毯恢复床
pivotSuggestion: top-center for hanging pieces; contact top-center for terrain; center for landmarks
qaFindings: 浅紫菌垫连续成床，低矮圆穹可读为软着陆区域；底部纤维形态较骨质，房间合成时应只突出软垫上层。
需root完成统一比例、透明深浅底和确定性房间合成验收；未作为已验收入库。

generationRequest.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated 2D game environment sprite on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, reference-guided redraw. Image1 supplies intended organ material and shape language; Image2 is the established delivered asset's matte gouache, clean dark ink contours, fine hand-painted texture and side-view only, do not copy its anatomy. Side-scrolling camera, very slight top-face visibility only where appropriate. Draw one complete coherent object with about 8% clear transparent padding, no scene, no floating multiple objects, no contact shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette. Full object uncropped. No characters, creatures, shelters, lamps, red ropes, rewards, symbols, labels, UI, ground patch, water or backdrop. No human stonework or invented portals.  Subject: ONE recovery landing bed of dense low fungal cushions over a small joined organic fibrous mat, dead whale R4, 10 hero units wide. Closely overlapping squat dome-shaped soft cushions, pale lavender and grayish cream, subtle radiating soft ridges as in the reference bottom area. A continuous broad low soft scalloped upper surface, varied cushion sizes but all form one integrated bed. Muted cool shadows, matte, no bright bioluminescent dots. It must read as forgiving soft landing, not spikes, rocks, tall mushrooms or a platform column. No distinct loose items, no red coral, shells, larvae, eyes, faces, bones, lamps or healing symbols.

method: 内置 imagegen 逐件生成或参考引导静态状态修改；原始 PNG 未裁切、降噪或抠图。
